platform: Gravitas Recordings Unreleased Private SoundCloud Demo Form Route
manual_review_reason: Gravitas provides a native demo form and says it listens to every submission. It accepts unreleased music and strongly prefers a mastered private SoundCloud playlist share link. The form also asks whether the music has been sent to other labels, requests artist context and allows optional social profiles. A human must approve the final master, unreleased and rights status, label fit, private-link permissions, exclusivity disclosure, biography and all live form fields before submission.

platform: Quality Goods Records Official Airtable Demo Submission Route
manual_review_reason: Quality Goods Records links a dedicated Demos destination from its official homepage, which redirects to a public Airtable form. The static extraction does not expose the complete live field set, file or link rules, rights declarations, consent text, submission limits or runtime challenge state. A human must inspect the live Airtable workflow, confirm track fit, ownership, master status, metadata and all declarations before entering data or sharing audio.

platform: Soma Records Protected Demo Email Two-Track SoundCloud Route
manual_review_reason: Soma publishes a dedicated demo mailbox through a protected/non-plaintext email link. It states that it is not currently looking to sign new artists but will listen to demos, asks for a SoundCloud link containing the best two tracks and a short message, and explicitly rejects download links, MP3 files and other attachments. A human must open the official contact link, verify the visible mailbox, select exactly two suitable tracks and approve the short pitch. The protected address must not be decoded or guessed automatically.

platform: Loci Records Public Contact Form Demo Routing Inquiry
manual_review_reason: Loci publishes an official contact form with name, email, phone and message fields, but no explicit current unsolicited-demo policy, audio field or authorized delivery format is stated. Queue only a brief asset-free inquiry asking whether demos are currently accepted and which official route and format should be used. A human must approve the inquiry and must not include audio files, private links or download links unless Loci replies with explicit instructions.

platform: CloudKid Public Business Email Demo Routing Inquiry
manual_review_reason: CloudKid publishes hello@cldkid.com as its general business contact in the official legal imprint but does not publish complete unsolicited-demo instructions on the accessible site. Queue only a short asset-free inquiry asking whether demos are open and which authorized route, format and metadata are required. A human must approve the message and must not attach audio or include private/download links until CloudKid explicitly authorizes music delivery.
